title: Durable checkpoint design (7 properties) + all in-scope defect corrections + adversarial replay coverage + simulated multi-unit advancement
objective: Amendment-22 window step 2 (D-024-R376..R388). Implement the seven-property durable checkpoint design: (1) front-loaded compact evidence-grounded orientation packet for every fresh/rotated worker (task, lineage, worktree, current progress, relevant files, exact required output); (2) required EARLY structured progress checkpoint + INCREMENTAL checkpoints during the unit; (3) a reserved FINAL turn exclusively for mandatory checkpoint emission before exhaustion, preventing exploratory tool use in that reserved turn wherever technically enforceable; (4) honest incomplete-but-resumable checkpoints never treated as completion or advancement; (5) working-turn allowances sized from the bounded task/workload class under a documented hard safety ceiling - NEVER merely raising the fixed max_turns; (6) fail-closed on incomplete checkpoint emission/validation/persistence/forwarding; (7) exactly-once checkpoint persistence and forwarding across crashes, restarts, rotations and duplicate provider output. Correct ALL in-scope defects from the M0-T125 register at ONE final frozen identity (R385). Build removal-sensitive AND adversarial coverage using the preserved real artifacts as READ-ONLY replay fixtures covering the full R387 sixteen-scenario minimum, plus SEVERAL CONSECUTIVE simulated bounded task advancements with no human intervention, no duplicate or lost work, no false acceptance, no unsafe effect (R388). PROHIBITIONS: R374 byte-for-byte preservation of all live evidence; R375 (no restart/clear-recovery/journal edit/repin/PR #241/policy weakening/owner-gate crossing/live launch). QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze rule): live counted stop no_valid_checkpoint at exactly 12/12 turns (M0-T107-amendment20-live-journey-2.md); window authorized by D-024-R372.
business_reason: Owner Amendment 22: the durable checkpoint design and one-identity defect corrections are the core of the final stabilization window
